fieldworkDocument.title: Measgaichte / Miscellaneous
fieldworkDocument.note: [NOTES: in IPA transcriptions, the fieldworker uses [w] for [ɯ].]

item.description: Quotation: leumadair-an-fheòir. Notes: grasshopper.
Notes: a green, fine kind of grass growing on sea rocks, in wells, etc.
[mu̜ʴstʹiɑxk] Notes: jellyfish. [NOTES: the turned r used for the symbol which is unclear in the original.]
Notes: porpoise.
Quotation: seòl stròineadh. Notes: lugsail.
Notes: crust of fine shells like barnacles on rocks.
Quotation: snàinean-biathaidh. Notes: parallel pieces of twine, placed from top to bottom in the middle of the lobster creel, with two sliding loops on them to secure bait.
Quotation: a’ spéiligeadh iasg. Notes: splitting fish by cutting it down the back close to the bone.
Notes: the strip of wood along the side of the boat and on which the seats lie.
Quotation: toll an fhàsaig. Notes: bung-hole.
[ɛlɛvɑɡ] Notes: the mooring ring on the stem of a boat.
Notes: the thin leaf next to the keel, lying on top of it.
Quotation: pl. bacan. Notes: fixed rowlock.
[biɤt̪ɑx] Notes: raven.
[bɾɔd̪ɾəɡɑṉ] Notes: robin redbreast.
[bɾɔlʹɑx] Quotation: am broilleach or am maide broillich. Notes: Bracket at joint between stempost and keel.
Notes: eel.
Notes: the stern in a square-sterned boat.
Quotation: na cnamhan móra. Notes: the large ribs in a boat.
Notes: perch.
Quotation: an cuairt-bheòil. Notes: the top plank.
Notes: a type of “partan” with a greenish-grey back. Very fast-moving.
Notes: puffin.
Notes: silvery, whelk-like shellfish.
Notes: bung in a boat.
Notes: skua.
[ɡɑrəɣɾiɑx] Notes: heron.
[ɡʹɑrəvɾɛxk] Notes: guillemot.
[ɡʹu̜:ɾɑṉ] Notes: gill of a fish.
Notes: swallow.
Notes: a flat seaweed.
[ɡwlwbwʴṉɑx] Notes: curlew. [NOTES: the turned r used for the symbol which is unclear in the original.]
